化、轉型提速」的態勢，市場運行愈發理性、                      overall market exhibited a trend characterized by “bottoming out and
回歸居住本源。                                   stabilizing, diverging, and accelerating transformation”. Market operations
                                          became increasingly rational and returned to the fundamental purpose of
                                          providing housing.

   員（「僱員」）所作出的貢獻及獎勵僱員對本                      the contribution of employees of the Company (the “Employees”)

   有益的優秀僱員。                                  future; and (ii) to attract and retain talented Employees who may be
                                             beneficial to the growth and development of the Group.

             集團能繼續營運，以為股東提供                                safeguard the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern

             少債務。

             資本總額計算。債務淨額按借款                                capital. Net debt is calculated as total borrowings and lease

    (ii) 估值方法                           (ii) Valuation techniques

        本集團就將予開發及在建投資物業分                   For investment properties to be developed and under
        別採用直接比較法及投資法。直接比                   development, the Group adopted direct comparison approach
        較法乃假設該等物業各自按現況交吉                   and investment approach, respectively. Direct comparison
        出售。經參考有關市場的銷售交易，                   approach assumes sale of each of these properties in its
        選擇鄰近地區的可資比較物業並就位                   existing status with the benefit of vacant possession. By making
        置及物業規模等因素的差異作出調整。                  reference to sales transactions as available in the relevant
                                           market, comparable properties in close proximity have been
                                           selected and adjustments have been made to account for the
                                           difference in factors such as locations and property size.

        投資法計及已產生建設成本及完成該                   Investment approach has taken into account the construction
        開發項目將產生的成本以反映已竣工                   costs incurred and the costs that will be incurred to complete the
        開發項目的質量，依據是該等物業將                   development to reflect the quality of the completed development
        根據本集團最近開發計劃開發和竣                    on the basis that the properties will be developed and
        工。就已竣工投資物業而言，估值根                   completed in accordance with the Group’s latest development
        據投資法透過將來自現有租約的淨租                   plan. For completed investment properties, valuations were
        金收入（經適當計及物業復歸潛在收                   based on investment approach by capitalisation of the net rental
        入）資本化，並經參考於活躍市場上的                  income derived from the existing tenancy agreements with due
        可資比較價格後作出。                         allowance for reversionary income potential of the properties and
                                           by reference to comparable price in an active market.

        年內估值方法並無變動。                        There were no changes to the valuation techniques during the
                                           year.
